statement: On ImageNet-1K with a ViT-S backbone at 224x224, nD-RoPE achieves 81.07% top-1, above RoPE-Axial 80.89% and RoPE-Mixed 80.90%.
domain: all 50,000 ImageNet-1K validation images under the paper's single-crop 224x224 protocol
assumptions: AdamW recipe specified in Appendix C
verification_rule: Exact checkpoint digests, 50,000 labeled per-example predictions, protocol metadata, and independently recomputed top-1 values must reproduce the reported ordering.
falsification_rule: A counterexample must satisfy every stated dataset, training, architecture, and evaluation assumption and contradict the reported numeric ordering.
